name: makkov-harness
description: A designer's harness for AI agents: curated skills, routing and security-checked companion plugins.

plugins.name: makkov-harness
plugins.description: Design Score for any page, report pages, install guard, design references, motion, HTML-to-video and a routing map that tells the agent which skill fits which situation.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: By Jesse Vincent. Brainstorming before building, systematic debugging, plans, verification. Pinned to the reviewed version.

plugins.name: interfaces
plugins.description: By Jakub Krehel. UI review: accessibility, typography, color, layout, UI copy. Pinned to the reviewed version (1.17.0).

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: By Paul Bakaus. Creative direction: shape, bolder, quieter, delight, onboarding, DESIGN.md. Pinned to the reviewed version (4.8.0). Turn telemetry off with `impeccable telemetry off`.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: By Nutlope. New landing pages and sites that look designed, not generated. Pinned to the reviewed version (2.0.0).

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: By Cloudflare. Whole-project security review before a launch. Pinned to the reviewed version.

plugins.name: ytlens
plugins.description: Watch and analyze YouTube videos (frames and audio) through Google Gemini. Needs your own Gemini API key.
